cases.name: testWhileComplexWithInlineLogicalExprs

       AND ( d IS SUPPLIED OR b IS NOT INITIAL )

cases.name: testAlignOpeningParentheses

  AND   a = c.
  ENDIF.

  IF a = b
  AND ( a = c ).
  ENDIF.

  IF ( a = b OR a = 1 )
  AND a = c
  OR ( b = c OR c = 1 ).
  ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  IF     ( a = b )
     AND a = c.
  ENDIF.

  IF     a = b
     AND ( a = c ).
  ENDIF.

  IF        ( a = b OR a = 1 )
        AND a = c
     OR ( b = c OR c = 1 ).
  ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

cases.name: testAlignOpeningParenthesesDeep
cases.src:
METHOD any_method.
  IF  (  (  a  =  b  OR  a  =  1  )
  AND  a  =  c
  OR ( b = c
  AND ( c = 1 ) ) )
  AND b = c.
  ENDIF.

  IF ( ( a = b OR a = 1 )
  AND ( a = c )
  OR ( ( b = c )
  AND  (  c  =  1  )  )  )
  AND ( b = c ).
  ENDIF.

  IF ( a = b
  OR c = d )
  AND a = c
  OR a = d
  AND  (  a  =  c  OR  b  =  d  ).
  ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
cases.exp:
METHOD any_method.
  IF     (        ( a = b OR a = 1 )
              AND a = c
           OR (     b = c
                AND ( c = 1 ) ) )
     AND b = c.
  ENDIF.

  IF     (        ( a = b OR a = 1 )
              AND ( a = c )
           OR (     ( b = c )
                AND ( c = 1 ) ) )
     AND ( b = c ).
  ENDIF.

  IF        (    a = b
              OR c = d )
        AND a = c
     OR     a = d
        AND ( a = c OR b = d ).
  ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
